title: fix(rest): the dataset query door judges admission on the refusal arm before it names holders (ADR-0150 D3 after ADR-0149 D2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuLPBRvpeugFUfuqRnBTBn8n)_

Fixes #32292 (limb 1. Limb 2 is withdrawn as not reproduced by the seat ruling 6817809380, Q3 = A; its census is under Acceptance notes, with no code change.)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`POST /analytics/dataset/query`（含批量接口的每一条查询）按名字读数据集被拒（同名有多个持有包）时，先判调用者能查哪些持有包，再作答。不能查的包不算候选，也不会在回答里出现；逐个持有包读取时遇到的拒绝也留在这一步里，不会原样答出去。
- 为什么改：调用者不该从拒绝信息里得知自己看不到的数据集属于哪个包。MCP 工具 `query_dataset` 早已是"先判准入再按包解析"，REST 门现在与它一致（ADR-0150 D3 在 ADR-0149 D2 之后）。
- 风险与回滚：只动"按名读被拒"这一支；按名读能解析出唯一项的回答一律不变，包括单一持有包时查询自身给出的 403。判不出准入且可能改变答案时答 503、什么都不跑；有一种行组合下，对所有持有包都有权限的调用者也会从 409 变成 503（已写进下表）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-admission-order.ts`（规则本体）；`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts` 里 `answerDatasetQuery` 的 catch 分支（只在拒绝时调用规则）；`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#32292]` 一组钉子。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics-routes.test.ts -t '#32292'`，预期 20 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`POST /analytics/dataset/query` resolved the saved dataset's name through the protocol's by-name read first, and judged the caller's admission only inside `queryDataset`. So when two packages held the name, a caller admitted to neither got `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. MCP `query_dataset` admits first and then applies D3 over the admitted holders (epic ruling 6766102988, point 1).

Now, when the by-name read **refuses** the name (bare read, `?callerPackage=`, or `?package=` naming a package that does not hold it), the door reads each refused holder's item at its exact `?package=` address and asks `admitDatasetCatalogEntry` (the analytics service's plugin-wired admission) which ones this caller may query. The rule lives in the new module `analytics-dataset-admission-order.ts` (`admitRefusedDatasetHolders`). A refusal that a holder's own read raises, of any reason and by class or by shape, leaves that holder undetermined and stays inside the rule: it is never answered as it is. The batch door answers each query through the same `answerDatasetQuery`, so it moves the same way.

Moved answers (Clause-② arm `yes (widening)`, as ruled in 6817809380). The epic red-line read 6834745545 reads the `409 → 404` row as neutral, a refusal becoming another refusal, and the `409 → 200` rows as the widening; the contract review 6834949539 reads the `409 → 503` row and the narrowed `409` as no narrowing either. For a caller admitted to fewer holders than the name has:

| Case | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| Admitted to none of the refused holders | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder | `404 NOT_FOUND`, byte-equal to the answer for a name nothing holds |
| An ambiguity (`ambiguous-in-environment`, `-in-closure`, `-in-namespace`) with exactly one holder admitted | `409` naming every holder | `200`, that holder's dataset runs |
| Two or more admitted, or a non-ambiguity refusal (`outside-closure`, `not-held-by-qualifier`) with any admitted | `409` naming every holder | `409` naming only the admitted holders |
| A holder whose admission cannot be judged, where it could change the answer | `409` naming every holder | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing run, no holder named |

For every caller, one admitted to every holder included:

| Case | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| Every refused holder's own exact-qualifier read refuses (no holder can be judged) | `409` naming every holder | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing run, no holder named, for as long as those reads refuse |
| Two holders in contention, and only one holder's saved dataset parses (a holder that does not parse counts for no caller, as in `query_dataset`) | `409` naming both | `200` for a caller who may query the one that parses (it runs); `404 NOT_FOUND` for any other caller |

Not moved:

- A name the by-name read **resolves** keeps its answer. One holder, the caller package's own item, its one closure item, or an exact `?package=` hit runs into `queryDataset`'s own gates, so a caller not admitted to it still gets their `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. Seat ruling Q1 = A: moving admission ahead of every read would turn every dashboard's `403` into `404`, which this card does not ask for.
- When the caller arm resolves to the caller package's own item or its one closure item and admission refuses, that answer stands. It never falls through to another package's dataset of the same name (Q2 = A).
- Two refusals are not judged and still name every holder: one from a service whose admission is not the plugin-wired set (`hasPluginWiredAdmission()` false: a hand-built service admits everyone), and one that names the environment or the platform as a candidate.

The epic scope note 6781265442 asked for the `?callerPackage=` arm to move too and to be pinned there as well as on the bare read and `?package=`. All three arms are pinned below.

`content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` gains one paragraph saying the same (the seat extended the claim's file surface to that one page, so this PR does not leave the page saying less than the door does).

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`, the `[#32292]` describe: 20 cases over the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`, with an analytics double whose admission admits by the dataset's object (as the real one judges the object read grant) and whose `queryDataset` throws the real `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 envelope where a pin needs the query gates. Where a pin needs a read the registry cannot stage, the protocol is wrapped in a proxy that changes only `getMetaItem` for one exact address. 11 cases came with b60e9776a; 890be0cd1 added 3, and the review rounds added 6 (ca94df5d0, 5cb8ea25f).

Measured red/green on head `5cb8ea25f` (main `2f80f2897` merged at `7499b616a`). Each ablation leg mutates through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proves the mutation on disk (anchor count 1 → 0, blob moved) and the restore (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). `packages/rest` tests import the door and the rule from source, so no rebuild is needed between legs.

- A0, main's door: in `analytics-routes.ts`, the refusal is rethrown before the rule runs (marker `ABLATE_32292_RETHROW`).
- A1: the narrowed refusal keeps every package candidate (`ABLATE_32292_ALL`).
- A2: the `503` arm is removed (`ABLATE_32292_NO503`).
- A3: an ambiguity with one admitted holder is not picked (`ABLATE_32292_NOPICK`).
- B0: a refusal from a holder's own read is let through (`ABLATE_32292_LETTHROUGH`).
- B1: a holder whose own address serves nothing is skipped instead of undetermined (`ABLATE_32292_SKIP`).
- B2: a refusal naming the environment is judged over its package candidates instead of answered as it is (`ABLATE_32292_NONPKG`).
- B3: a holder whose saved dataset does not parse counts as admitted (`ABLATE_32292_PARSE`).
- B4: the rule recognises a refusal by class only, not by shape (`ABLATE_32292_NOSHAPE`).
- M: `origin/main`'s own `analytics-routes.ts` blob (`8a88b63d`) under this head's tests, restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` and checked equal to HEAD's blob.

| Pin | HEAD | A0 | A1 | A2 | A3 | B0 | B1 | B2 | B3 | B4 | M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| admitted to neither holder: 404 NOT_FOUND, byte-equal to the answer for a name nothing holds; neither is named, nothing run | green | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| admitted to exactly one of two holders: that one runs, in either order, and the hidden holder is never named | green | **red** | green | green | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| admitted to two of three holders: 409 naming only those two; the hidden third is never named, nothing run | green | **red** | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| CONTROL: admitted to both holders: 409 naming both, as before | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green |
| the caller arm: two holders in P's closure are judged the same way (none → 404, one → runs, never the hidden one named) | green | **red** | green | green | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| outside P's closure and `?package=` naming a non-holder are never picked: admitted → 409 naming only the admitted, none → 404 | green | **red** | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| a holder whose admission cannot be judged, where it could move the answer: 503, no holder named, nothing run | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| a name the read resolves keeps its answer: admission is not asked, and the one holder runs into queryDataset's own gates | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green |
| the caller arm resolved to P's own item never falls through to a dependency's item of the name | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green |
| one holder the caller is not admitted to keeps queryDataset's 403, never moved to 404 (Q1 = A), and admission is not asked | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green |
| the caller arm resolved to its one closure item keeps that item's 403 and never falls through to a holder outside the closure (Q2 = A) | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green |
| the caller arm: three holders in the closure, two admitted: 409 naming only those two; the hidden one is never named, nothing run | green | **red** | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| a holder whose own exact-qualifier read refuses is undetermined: 503 on every arm, for every caller, naming no holder and running nothing | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| a holder whose own address serves nothing is undetermined where it could move the answer: 503, nothing run | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | green | **red** | green | green | green | **red** |
| a refusal one of whose candidates is the environment is answered as it is: admission is not asked | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | **red** | green | green | green |
| a holder whose saved dataset does not parse counts for no caller: admitted to both objects, the other holder runs | green | **red** | green | green | **red** | green | green | green | **red** | green | **red** |
| ?package= naming a holder whose own address refuses: 503 for every caller, naming no holder and running nothing | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| a per-holder read's refusal of any reason, by class or by shape, is undetermined: 503, and its own candidates are never answered | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | **red** | green | green | green | **red** | **red** |
| a service whose admission is not the plugin-wired set is not asked: the refusal names every holder, as before | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green | green |
| the batch door judges each query the same way: a hidden name's entry is byte-equal to a missing name's | green | **red** | green | green | **red** | green | green | green | green | green | **red** |
| **Totals** | 20/20 green | 13 red | 3 red | 5 red | 4 red | 3 red | 1 red | 1 red | 1 red | 1 red | 13 red |

Every negative pin goes red under A0 and under M, and each targeted leg reds the pins of its own arm. Every control stays green on every leg.

## Acceptance notes

- **Limb 2 census (withdrawn, Q3 = A), re-read on this head:** two served-list doors keep one row per holder. `savedHoldersOf` in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts` (around line 267, the dataset tools) keeps a holder's first row that parses, else its first row. `listSkillPrompts` and the face resolution in `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts` (around lines 167 and 247, skill `prompts/get`) keep the first row per holder. Both read one merged list, which carries one overlaid row per package, and the stdio fallback lists no package dataset rows, so no host in the tree feeds them two rows of one package: no reach. The agent roster `readAgentRoster` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` (around line 1131) lists every row and picks none. No code change.
- **Branch name:** `claude/project-thread-elxrlt` is the card thread's harness-pinned branch (claim 6817615501), a platform exception to `claude/issue-N-slug`.
- **History:** developed on the blocker head `claude/project-thread-phk4r9` and kept there until PR #32497 landed (`0763bf6ec`). Main `2f80f2897` is merged in at `7499b616a`, never rebased. All ten files `git show --remerge-diff` lists for that merge (`.changeset/32183-disabled-package-holds-no-name.md`, `stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts`, core `security-catalog.ts` and its test, `stored-permission-set-package-backfill.test.ts`, `meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, runtime `automation-address.ts` and `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, service-automation `engine.ts` and `stored-reference-package-column.test.ts`) belong to #32497, and each one's merged blob equals `origin/main`'s. After the merge, `git diff origin/main...HEAD` is this card's files only.
